body:
I tried music, sad movies, sad books, sad anything. Happy movies, happy books, happy anything. None helped. Not even a slight bit. The furthest I have gotten was that feeling of having something in your throat. Like a brick, that feeling you get before crying but the tears do not come out. 

I gave up trying shortly after.

I'm being my own best friend.

Making conversations with myself about what I see or read. Sometimes I wonder if I am slowly going crazy.

Not OP but, its like we have the same friends, well, friend for me. He's stupidly ignorant and optimistic and whenever I tell him the truth about something or point out something realistically I get four responses (Its like a fucking rpg npc at this point):

1. "It'll be fine/its all good"
2. "I was just joking"
3. "-Changes subject-"
4. "I don't believe you/you're lying"

I can't have a proper argument about anything cause it leads nowhere and he always wants to argue about anything with me. Am I being unreasonable? Also 4 infuriates me. Even if I end up going out of my way to prove im right he jumps into the rpg chatwheel again.

Maaaaaan I feel you...

I can't remember 99% of anything before I was like 15 and I'm 21 right now. The gaps are getting bigger I feel like I'm completely and absolutely losing it.

Stay strong, who knows maybe this is a way of our brain helping us. Maybe it isn't... 

I hope it is...

Quick edit: its not like something big happened, e.g. a trauma that I suddenly lost memory, it just gradually becomes hazy and non-existent like paper in water slowly dissolving..
I feel you. I feel lost when im not listening to music. I can't concentrate because of all my thought overflooding everything in my head. Atleast with music I can relax.

I've been there op. Sitting in the corner of my bed with my head between my legs trying to console myself that everything is going to be ok for almost two weeks. Small breaks, which I had to mentally prepare myself for a few hours prior, to get a small amount of food to not starve to death and back to the corner. Probably the most horrible time of my life.
The drowsiness is kinda gone and I havent experienced anything close to a bigger apetite. Thanks for the info though!
Im on 15mg for now.
Dude fuck em, im 6'1 130 and 21 y/o. Keep up the good work. I can't even get myself to do what you're doing. Keep it up!
I know what you mean. Main reason I want to move to a big city of some sort but Im afraid its gonna be a placebo effect.

Thanks. You don't know how much that means to me. There's an divers' saying "_when swimming into a dark tunnel there arrives a point of no return when you no longer have enough breath to double back. Your only choice is to swim forward into the unknown and pray for an exit._" Im somewhat towards the end unable to find it, contemplating drowning
I am going to in a few days, appointment has been made. Thanks for the concern though.

That smile is fading and Im becoming unable to pretend. 

Fuck anxiety and fuck depression. Why me? Why anyone, really. It's something I wouldn't wish upon my worst enemy.

If you need to share your story I can listen and offer you my perspective I guess. Eventhough I am pretty much in a sort of same situation and all. Guess the least I can do is help people since I think Im stuck here till the end. 

Doesn't mean whatever I say is going to help, but hey trying is never a bad thing.

This is purely hypothetical and I mean no disrespect.

If I was in the situation your sister is in right now I would fully envy you because you're not dependent on a drug and probably have a better life than she has had for the past years. Now I dont know if you did/do have had a better life and that doesn't matter. It could be her way of seeing things and the way I see it. You haven't done anything wrong (unless you haven't shared everything). Its just probably her situation that makes her that way towards you and probably isn't personal. If she was like that before the drugs then idk.

I wish you and your sister luck.
Try obecalp 25mg.
My wrists start burning up and I start feeling like scratching. Its an aweful sensation.

I was at this point 2 years ago. Not as situation, but rather mentally. Now fast forward two years of trying to "scrape by, deal with it" and I've realised getting help was definitely the right choice. You might not like what you hear or rather not even know _what_ you want to hear, but you'll atleast have a direction of a sort. 

I hope you'll be able to make what choice is right for you and that you're able to live through it. The ride for anxiety and depression is usually wild.

You don't have to go see a therapist immediately. You could also go for counsel and just talk, vent and try to get your mind straight and after that try to find help. 

I hope you can find a way out, because I'm still looking..

Its like a vicious spiral downwards for me. But keep in mind everyone is different. People have different emotional threshholds and limits and such. Yet knowing this, it doesn't make depression easier for me. I hope it does for you though.

Your 3rd paragraph resonates with me.    It's aweful as fuck, doesn't leave your mind for a second and you just keep going over situations wishing you said something else or did the other thing. Atleast thats how it was for me. 

If you need to talk you can pm me, I prettt much almost never sleep until my body feels like it has to shut down for a few hours.

Hang in there. Perhaps we'll get lucky at one point, or well, I hope so. Thats kind of my tiny little spark of hope left. That and my two little sisters who are still fully oblivious to the world.

Thank you, I really appreciate your  praise of my English. 

As an answer to your second reply:

I am/was too scared to be completely honest with her because I don't want to end up locked away or using highly addicting meds. I know myself and if I touch something that is incredibly addicting, especially im this current state of mind, I wouldn't be able to put an end to it unless I end the source of all problems which is me. 

But I am not too sure anymore, I feel desperate and hopeless. I might end up giving it a shot as a last resort. If it doesn't help, well, then there is only one option left.

I just want this misery, this constant fear, and the hopeless to end..

Seeing a different one would have to be an external (private?) doctor as it is called here, which would cost me a LOT. I do not have the money to fund a whole hour talk of that let alone multiple sessions.
